intent_en: Show that large losses of Black residents occurred across many major US cities rather than in only two or three places.
narration_support: It's not just in two or three cities, but it's in a lot of cities across the country. Northern cities, southern cities, western cities. African Americans started to make this move, especially in the last 20 or 25 years. Really large numbers of blacks moved to the south.
